title: Tonkotsu Ramen with Japanese-Style Paneer
description: A creamy and savory Japanese-inspired ramen dish featuring pan-seared paneer, rich tonkotsu broth, and a variety of umami flavors.

ingredients.name: Tonkotsu Broth
ingredients.notes: Made by simmering pork bones and tonkotsu in water

ingredients.name: Japanese-Style Paneer
ingredients.notes: Pan-seared paneer marinated in soy sauce and sake

ingredients.name: Shiitake Mushrooms
ingredients.notes: Sliced shiitake mushrooms for added flavor

ingredients.name: Green Onions
ingredients.notes: Thinly sliced green onions for garnish

ingredients.name: Umami Spice Blend
ingredients.notes: A combination of soy sauce, sake, and mirin for added umami flavor

instructions: 1. In a large pot, combine Tonkotsu Broth and Umami Spice Blend. Simmer for 10 minutes.
2. While the broth is simmering, prepare the Japanese-Style Paneer by marinating it in soy sauce and sake for 10 minutes.
3. Pan-sear the paneer in a hot skillet until golden brown.
4. Cook the Ramen Noodles according to package instructions.
5. Slice the Shiitake Mushrooms and add them to the Tonkotsu Broth for added flavor.
6. To assemble the dish, place cooked noodles in a bowl, top with pan-seared paneer, and garnish with green onions.
7. Ladle the Tonkotsu Broth over the top of the dish.
